# zig-notify -- Complete API Reference

> Cross-platform desktop notification library in Zig with C FFI -- macOS (osascript) and Linux (libnotify).

Part of the [Tinyland Zig Libraries](https://libs.tinyland.dev). License: Zlib OR MIT.

## Installation

```
zig fetch --save git+https://github.com/Jesssullivan/zig-notify.git
```

Then in build.zig:

```zig
const dep = b.dependency("zig-notify", .{ .target = target, .optimize = optimize });
exe.root_module.addImport("zig-notify", dep.module("zig-notify"));
```

Or as a git submodule for C FFI consumers:

```
git submodule add https://github.com/Jesssullivan/zig-notify.git vendor/notify
cd vendor/notify && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast
```

Link (macOS): `-lzig-notify` (no frameworks; uses osascript binary).
Link (Linux): `-lzig-notify -lnotify -lglib-2.0 -lgobject-2.0`.
Include: `#include "zig_notify.h"`.

## Source Structure

- `src/ffi.zig` - C FFI exports (4 functions)
- `src/notify.zig` - Platform dispatch (comptime macOS/Linux selection)
- `src/notify_macos.zig` - macOS backend (osascript `display notification`)
- `src/notify_linux.zig` - Linux backend (libnotify GLib API)
- `include/zig_notify.h` - C header (4 functions + urgency enum)
- `examples/send_notification.c` - C usage example

## C API Reference (zig_notify.h)

### Types

- `zig_notify_urgency_t` - Enum: `ZIG_NOTIFY_URGENCY_LOW` (0), `ZIG_NOTIFY_URGENCY_NORMAL` (1), `ZIG_NOTIFY_URGENCY_CRITICAL` (2).

### zig_notify_init

```c
int zig_notify_init(const char *app_name, size_t app_name_len);
```

Initialize the notification backend. Must be called before `zig_notify_send` on Linux, where it calls `notify_init(app_name)` to register the application with libnotify. No-op on macOS. `app_name` must be at most 255 bytes. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

### zig_notify_send

```c
int zig_notify_send(
    const char *title, size_t title_len,
    const char *body, size_t body_len,
    zig_notify_urgency_t urgency
);
```

Send a desktop notification with the given title, optional body, and urgency level. `body` may be NULL (set `body_len` to 0) for title-only notifications. Title is limited to 511 bytes, body to 2047 bytes.

On macOS: executes `osascript -e 'display notification ...'`. Urgency is accepted but ignored (macOS has no urgency concept).
On Linux: calls `notify_notification_new` + `notify_notification_show` with the requested urgency.

Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

### zig_notify_request_permission

```c
int zig_notify_request_permission(void);
```

Request notification permission from the operating system. On macOS this would use `UNUserNotificationCenter.requestAuthorization`; the current implementation returns 0 immediately because the osascript backend does not require explicit permission. On Linux there is no permission model. Returns 0 if granted, -1 if denied, -2 on error.

### zig_notify_deinit

```c
void zig_notify_deinit(void);
```

Clean up notification backend resources. On Linux, calls `notify_uninit()` to release libnotify state. Should be called once on application exit. No-op on macOS.

## Zig API Reference

### notify.zig (platform dispatch)

- `Urgency` - Enum: `low` (0), `normal` (1), `critical` (2). Maps to libnotify urgency on Linux.
- `send(title: []const u8, body: ?[]const u8, urgency: Urgency) !void` - Send a notification. Routes to macOS or Linux backend at comptime. Returns `error.UnsupportedPlatform` on other OS.
- `init(app_name: []const u8) !void` - Initialize backend (Linux: `notify_init`, macOS: no-op).
- `deinit() void` - Clean up backend (Linux: `notify_uninit`, macOS: no-op).

### notify_macos.zig

- `send(title, body, urgency) !void` - Build and execute `osascript -e 'display notification "body" with title "title"'`. Urgency ignored. 2048-byte command buffer. Returns `error.SpawnFailed` or `error.WaitFailed`.

### notify_linux.zig

- `init(app_name) !void` - Call `notify_init`. 256-byte name buffer. Returns `error.NameTooLong` or `error.NotifyInitFailed`.
- `deinit() void` - Call `notify_uninit` if initialized.
- `send(title, body, urgency) !void` - Create and show a `NotifyNotification`. 512-byte title buffer, 2048-byte body buffer. Returns `error.NotInitialized`, `error.TitleTooLong`, `error.BodyTooLong`, `error.NotificationCreateFailed`, or `error.NotificationShowFailed`.

## Error Convention

- C FFI functions returning `int`: 0 on success, -1 on failure.
- `request_permission`: 0 = granted, -1 = denied, -2 = error.
- Zig API uses error unions (`!T`).

## Thread Safety

On macOS, `send` spawns an `osascript` child process per call -- thread-safe but not suitable for high-frequency use. On Linux, libnotify functions are not thread-safe; call from a single thread or synchronize externally. `init` and `deinit` must be called from the same thread.

## Build

```
zig build                        # static library
zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast # optimized build
zig build test                   # unit tests
zig build docs                   # generate API docs
```

## Platform Support

- macOS 13+ (arm64/x86_64): osascript backend, no frameworks or libraries needed.
- Linux (x86_64/arm64): libnotify backend, requires `libnotify-dev` (apt) or `libnotify-devel` (dnf) + glib-2.0 + gobject-2.0.
- A running notification daemon is required on Linux (dunst, mako, GNOME Shell, etc.).
